# Parikh Global Admissions

> Parikh Global Admissions is a private college admissions counseling and high school planning firm based in South Florida, advising students and families in person across South Florida and virtually nationwide and internationally. Founded in 2010, the firm has guided 10,000+ students, helped families earn $25M+ in scholarships, and publishes its pricing openly (plans start at $3,200/year). Its philosophy is early, multi-year strategic planning rather than senior-year scrambling, honest and realistic guidance with no guaranteed-admission claims, and strict AI ethics — technology is used for research and logistics only, never to write a student's essays or voice for them.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/): Overview of college admissions counseling services, firm stats, and philosophy.
- [About Us](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/about.html): Team credentials, South Florida office locations, and national/virtual reach.
- [Our Philosophy](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/philosophy.html): Vision, mission, global admissions strategy, and AI ethics policy.
- [Services Overview](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/services.html): Summary of all three service lines and the milestone-driven advising process.
- [Pricing](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/pricing.html): Published, transparent pricing tiers for high school planning, application season, and multi-year partnerships.
- [FAQs](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/faqs.html): Answers on getting started, approach, academics/testing, applications/essays, specialized pathways, and logistics.
- [Schedule a Consultation](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/schedule-consultation.html): Request a free introductory consultation.

## Services

- [College & Graduate School Advising](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/services/college-graduate-school.html): Undergraduate, transfer, graduate school, and BS/MD & pre-professional admissions counseling.
- [High School Planning](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/services/high-school-planning.html): Academic planning, course selection and rigor, testing strategy, and extracurricular planning for grades 8-12.
- [Specialized Pathways](https://parikhglobaladmissions.com/services/specialized-pathways.html): NCAA athletic recruiting advising, neurodiverse student support, and international/global admissions counseling.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- The firm does not guarantee college acceptances; ethical advising guarantees a thoughtful process, honest feedback, and authentic applications — not outcomes.
- Pricing is public and non-negotiable-by-inquiry: see the Pricing page for current tiers rather than estimating a figure.
- Contact: hello@parikhglobaladmissions.com. Consultations are by appointment, in person (South Florida) or virtual (nationwide/international).
